prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production PNG sprite atlas for a top-down 2D cozy farming RPG, rich HD pixel art at a coherent 32px tile scale, crisp pixels not vector shapes. Create one 1536x1024 transparent sprite sheet with precisely SIX COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS equal 256x256 cells. Each cell contains ONE isolated centered object, with at least 16px padding, no overlaps, no labels, no text, no grid lines, transparent background. Exact objects by row left to right: row1: rustic warm timber farmhouse with sage green tiled roof and small porch; matching village seed shop with terracotta tiled roof awning and flower boxes; irregular leafy spring oak tree with pink tiny blossoms; leafy lush summer oak; golden copper autumn oak; snowy winter oak. row2: fenced wooden shipment crate; rustic round stone well; wooden barrel; ornate wooden signpost with leaf icon no text; flower patch with cream daisies and pink flowers; irregular gray stones and moss. row3: carrot plant with orange roots; turnip plant with white purple roots; potato bush with golden tubers; tomato plant with ripe red tomatoes; tall corn plant with cobs; strawberry plant with red berries. row4: pumpkin vine with orange pumpkins; cabbage plant with layered pale green leaves; watering can tool; garden hoe tool; woven seed bag with sprouting leaf; brown-haired farmer wearing straw hat cream shirt green overalls facing viewer, whole body. Highly detailed individual pixel clusters, restrained dark umber outlines, sun from upper left, amber highlights, blue green shadows. View like a high-quality original indie farming game, top-down three-quarter orthographic view NO isometric diamonds. Each sprite cleanly separated, no floor backgrounds or scenery. Buildings fill cells, other objects fill most of their cell. Keep every item entirely inside its assigned cell. Create original designs, no copyrighted game assets.
prompts.characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original precise pixel art character sprite sheet for a top-down cozy farming game, transparent background. Square 1024x1024 arranged EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal 256x256 cells with ample transparent padding. One full-body same farmer sprite in each cell. Young adult brown-haired farmer with straw hat, cream sleeves, sage green overalls, russet boots, no weapon. Row1 faces south toward viewer, row2 faces west left profile, row3 faces east right profile, row4 faces north back view. Columns depict four frames of walking cycle: left foot ahead, neutral feet, right foot ahead, neutral feet. Keep SAME size, design, body proportions and feet baseline in all16cells. Detailed crisp retro pixel clusters and earthy outlines at native approximate 32x48 pixel resolution, presented at enlarged resolution, no smooth illustration. Original design, warm top left light, readable expressive cozy character, realistic alternating arm leg positions, NO text no labels no background floor no grids no overlapping. Entire hat and boots inside each cell.
